overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong, scholarly social media presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon with a total audience of 3,580 followers. His content consistently focuses on computational social science, disinformation research, software tools (CooRnet), and academic hiring/opportunities, driving high relative engagement across all networks.

contentThemes.description: Research updates, published papers, and methodologies regarding information operations and coordinated inauthentic behavior.
Announcements and releases related to computational social science tools like CooRnet.
Postdoc job postings and PhD research opportunities within computational social science.

recommendations: Cross-promote content consistently, adapting the tone for each network (e.g., professional funding news on LinkedIn, interactive discussion on Mastodon and Bluesky).
Increase post frequency on high-performing platforms like Bluesky where engagement rates per follower are highest.
Include visual media or links to publication preprints/tool repositories to drive higher click-throughs and amplification.

platformInsights.bluesky: Achieves the highest engagement rate (average 6.14%), driven by strong amplification via reposts on research announcements and PhD recruitment.
platformInsights.mastodon: Serves a focused academic audience with solid engagement on tool updates (CooRnet v2.0) and methodological discussions.
platformInsights.linkedin: Drives the largest absolute engagement counts (highest likes and comments) due to its larger audience base of 1,850 followers, performing exceptionally well for grant awards and job postings.
